title: Backend Software Engineer
company_profile: Northwind Analytics builds data tools for retailers. Founded in 2009, we have 250 employees across three offices and a long record of customer success.
description: We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and maintain Python services, review code with teammates, take part in on-call rotations and work closely with product managers to ship features every two weeks.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience. 3+ years of experience with Python and SQL. Good communication skills.
benefits: Health insurance, 401(k) matching, 25 days of paid leave, learning budget.

title: Registered Nurse - Pediatrics
company_profile: St. Mary's Regional Hospital has served the Houston community for over 60 years with 400 beds and a nationally recognized pediatric unit.
description: Provide direct patient care in our pediatric unit, administer medications, document care in the electronic health record and coordinate with physicians and families. Shifts are 12 hours, three days per week.
requirements: Active Texas RN license. BLS and PALS certification. At least 1 year of pediatric experience preferred.
benefits: Medical, dental and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, retirement plan, shift differentials.

title: Marketing Coordinator
company_profile: Brightside Foods is a London-based producer of organic snacks sold in more than 2,000 UK stores. Our team of 80 is passionate about sustainable food.

requirements: Degree in marketing or communications. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role. Strong writing skills and familiarity with social media tools.
benefits: 25 days holiday, pension scheme, free snacks, hybrid working.

title: Data Analyst
company_profile: Klarwerk GmbH develops energy management software for industrial customers. We employ 120 people and work with clients in 14 countries.
description: Analyze customer usage data, build dashboards in Tableau and present insights to the product team. You will write SQL queries daily and help define the metrics used to measure product success.
requirements: Degree in statistics, economics or related field. Solid SQL skills. Experience with Tableau or Power BI. English fluency required.
benefits: Flexible hours, public transport pass, annual training budget, pension plan.

title: Chef de projet informatique

description: Vous pilotez des projets de développement applicatif, animez les équipes agiles, suivez le budget et le planning, et assurez la communication avec les clients. Vous rendez compte au directeur de programme.
requirements: Diplôme d'ingénieur ou master en informatique. 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet. Maîtrise de Scrum et de Jira.
benefits: Mutuelle, tickets restaurant, 10 jours de RTT, télétravail 2 jours par semaine.

title: Customer Support Specialist
company_profile: Cloudly is a software company with over 15,000 customers worldwide. Our support team is recognized for fast response times and friendly service.
description: Answer customer questions by chat and email, troubleshoot account problems and escalate technical issues to engineering. You will document solutions in our help center and suggest improvements to the product team.
requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. 1 year of customer service experience. Excellent written communication.
benefits: Health insurance, paid time off, remote-friendly culture, annual bonus.

title: Mechanical Engineer
company_profile: Maple Industrial Systems designs and manufactures packaging machinery. Established in 1985, we operate plants in Ontario and Quebec.

requirements: Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering. 2-4 years of experience in machine design. P.Eng. designation an asset.
benefits: Group benefits, pension plan, relocation assistance, professional development.

title: Primary School Teacher
company_profile: Harbour View Public School is a primary school with 450 students and a strong record in literacy and numeracy programs.

benefits: Competitive salary per award, superannuation, professional learning days.
